body:
This doesn't appear to be `cy.click` related at all. The error message is talking about not being able to find the DOM element, which means its failing on `cy.get`. 

Why are you using `cy.get` as opposed to `cy.contains` which finds elements by their contents?
Oh nevermind, I see that you mean the click isn't causing the dropdown's contents to appear in the DOM. Disregard what I said.

This issue only occurs headlessly and does not occur even when invoking the binary directly with the `--show-headless-gui` option. 

This is definitely a bug. We'll have to investigate it further. 

Thanks again for opening the issue!
Not only headlessly, sometimes it can be reproduced with Electron 53 in gui.
Hope we can have native events soon, so we don't have to come up with such tricks anymore. I believe it should be as simple as `cy.get('div.Select-control:first').click()`.

There are a ton of bug fixes for `cy.type` in `0.20.0`. We'll introduce native events when chromium adds multiplexing support to the debugger protocol. If we added it now you'd lose Dev Tools access when running tests in Cypress.

issue.title: My test passes `cypress open` but fails with `cypress run`

repository.name: cypress
repository.description: Fast, easy and reliable testing for anything that runs in a browser.

body:
I face some related problem - the focus events only work, when the electron window has os native focus. So running the electron UI in the background or headless causes failing tests because UI elements are shown because of missing blur event.
Keeping the UI open and manually focus the window all tests passes fine.
There is already a bug report https://github.com/cypress-io/cypress/issues/1176 about the blur event problem
Curious to see if this is resolved in #1275
@jennifer-shehane tried the current develop branch with Electron 59. Still the same issue.

The problem is not resolved yet.
It's actually originating from `react-select` and I wonder if cypress can actually work around the issue there without solving the root cause itself.
The problem is that react-select dropdown won't open when the window is not focused. For example, even when you use the full gui browser but you open devtools and your window focus is on devtools instead of the app window, it still won't open.

The `input` solution that was suggested above indeed works, but obviously only for input enabled react-select. No input still causes problems.
We currently worked around this by running `--browser chrome --headed` (unfortunately, since it's not ideal).

@nitzansan We made some improvements to Electron's focusing and `document.hasFocus()` in version [`3.0.2`](https://docs.cypress.io/changelog#3-0-2) that was causing behavior similar to this - with dropdowns closing/not opening correctly due to focus issues. 

Has anyone tried this on the latest version?
@bencao thanks for this. I'll try to reproduce, and I'll update this with any timeline for a fix

It also works if you type a string with an empty space
```js
cy
    .get('div.Select input')
    .first()
   // It will show all the options
    .type(' ', { force: true })
    .get('.Select-option')
    .first()
    .click()
```
Works for headed mode (Chrome 67) and headless mode (Chrome 59)
Cypress 3.0.2
